title: Support The Show
html:
The Road to Episode 666

It’s not a celebration…it’s preparation! Thats right... it’s episode 600, which means episode 666 is on its way. Obviously this is a conundrum. So instead of celebrating episode 600, we’re taking the next 66 episodes to prepare for battle!

For this, we are offering an automatic producership subscription of $10.10 PER EPISODE, starting on episode 600 and ending on episode 666! This will get a producer to Knight or Damehood at the Canary Cry Roundtable in 66 episodes! (Much how the 66 books of the Bible prepare us for the IRL MOTB)

Like the episode 500 Roundtable Pledge, this will also include receiving the “Refuse the Mark, Crush the Beast” challenge coin! (pics to come!)

Take the pledge! (non-paypal)
